title: Allowing selecting day from other months
line: Clicking a greyed-out day of the previous or next month in the calendar now switches to that month and selects the day, and the arrow keys move across month edges.
explanation: Since plasma-workspace !5614 the calendar's days from the previous and next month were disabled buttons, so their faint text was exempt from WCAG contrast rules. As a result clicks on them were ignored, they had no hover, and the arrow keys stopped at the edge of the month (Up/Down refused to enter them and focus could not land on them). The change enables those cells again: clicking one selects that day and scrolls to its month, and moving keyboard focus onto one scrolls to its month and focuses the same day there. Their text and event dots now use 0.7 opacity instead of 0.5, which still sets them apart but reaches AA contrast (4.78:1 measured on Breeze, was 1.7:1).

commits.message:
calendar: let days of other months open their month

Days of the previous and next month were disabled, so clicking them or
reaching them with the arrow keys did nothing. Now they go to their
month and select or focus that day, drawn with enough contrast for AA.

BUG: 528382

media.caption: November view: hovering and clicking 2 December does nothing.
Clicking 2 December scrolls to December with the 2nd selected.
Keyboard focus on 30 November: Right and Down do nothing.
Arrow keys: Right from 31 December scrolls to January with the 1st focused; Left goes back to 31 December.
Other-month days drawn as disabled (1.7:1 contrast).
Other-month days still dimmer, now 4.78:1 contrast (WCAG AA).
